name: elevenlabs
description: Audio generation with ElevenLabs, driven through the elevenlabs-cli command: text to speech in any language, multi-speaker dialogue with natural turn-taking, guided pieces rendered as one take and re-timed to exact pauses, sound effects, local noise beds, transcription, and a measured voice-casting funnel with a persistent trial lab. Four skills: generate (automatic), casting, check-updates and improve (invoked by name), plus setup.
